metadata.title: The foundation for your next SaaS.
metadata.description: A production-ready SaaS starter with passwordless auth, workspaces, an AI assistant, a document library, notifications, and a public API.

navbar.mobileNavigationDescription: Explore the product and get started

hero.title: Ship your SaaS, not the boilerplate.
hero.description: Authentication, workspaces, an AI assistant, and an API are already built, so you can start on what makes your product different.

features.title: Everything a modern SaaS needs, from day one.

workspaces.title: Auth and workspaces
workspaces.description: Passwordless sign-in with email codes or Google, plus workspaces with members, roles, and invitations.

assistant.title: AI assistant
assistant.description: Chat with tools, approvals, memory, and web search, grounded in your own documents.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: In-app and email notifications, ready to wire into your own events.

api.title: API and MCP
api.description: A typed internal API, a REST and OpenAPI surface with API keys, and an MCP server.

production.title: Global and production-ready
production.description: English and Arabic with full RTL, observability, and quality checks built in.

included.question: What’s included?
included.answer: Authentication, workspaces with members and API keys, a dashboard with an AI assistant, a document and image library, notifications, an MCP server, and a REST API.

customize.question: How do I make it my own?
customize.answer: Change the brand, copy, and colors, remove what you don’t need, and build your features on the existing patterns for the API, services, and UI.

deploy.question: Can I deploy it?
deploy.answer: Yes. It runs anywhere that hosts Next.js, with PostgreSQL and Redis alongside it.

production.question: Is it production-ready?
production.answer: It ships with error handling, logging, rate limiting, migrations, tests, and a CI quality gate, so you start from a solid base.

cta.title: Your product starts here.
cta.description: Sign in, create a workspace, and see everything that’s already built.

footer.tagline: The foundation for your next SaaS.
footer.note: Built on a modern, typed stack, ready for whatever you build next.

items.3: Usage and device information, such as your IP address, browser, and the pages you visit
